title: I'm not mad at these
text:
I'm not mad at these. Amazon on some stuff and won't upload my pics. Nonetheless, these are decent cups. I got these because I had a difficult time finding regular holders for my jumbo cupcake pans. There was no smell or residue left behind. I did spray a Lil oil in them tho, just in case. I'm not sure if I'll get them again but I've a ton to use and thus, hopefully, figure out how to deal with the issues they posed.

Fortunately, I'm not a Baker and can deal with the issues, for now. I used these to hold mini apple pies. It was really tough to get the dough in and stay put. Thin crust cooks well but falls apart, so next time I'll make the dough thicker. For now, the pies need to stay in the paper if used. I also made some cupcakes. The paper opened while baking and made the cupcakes look like flowers. Great, unless you don't want your cupcakes to look like flowers. I could care less, since baking isn't my area of expertise. However, I did want to try making pot pies in these and now I'm thinking twice about that.

Good luck to you
